title: adjudication verdict — record schema (Home-2 semantics)
description: Validates the `adjudication` object carried at model_attestation.compute_attestation.adjudication of a sealed capsule (capsule-emit adjudication.py). Fixes the closed set of verdict SHAPES this outcome convention registers: corroborated | inconclusive | contradicted:<owner_id>. The capsule's chain.relation='adjudicates' value and disposition.verdict_class='assessed' are cited by this same entry (see mesh-inference-exchange-style Home-1/Home-2 split notes in adjudication-verdict.yaml) but are not independently schema-checked here -- the verdict field is this entry's registered vocabulary.

verdict.description: Closed set of SHAPES (not literal values for 'contradicted', which carries an owner_id suffix): 'corroborated', 'inconclusive', or 'contradicted:<owner_id>' with a non-empty owner_id.

margin.description: Exact decimal string (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3) -- never a JSON float in this digest-bearing field.

margin_tau.description: Exact decimal string, same rule as margin.
